exercises.instructionMarkdown: A logic-level MOSFET is driven from a 3.3 V GPIO. Which datasheet entry confirms it is fully enhanced?
choices: A threshold voltage VGS(th) of 2 V, since 3.3 V is above it
RDS(on) specified at VGS = 3.3 V or lower
hints: Threshold is where conduction starts, not where RDS(on) is low.

exercises.title: MOSFETs and Power Switching: worked analysis
exercises.instructionMarkdown:
Estimate conduction and switching loss for a logic-level MOSFET driving a PWM load.

Show assumptions, equations, units, standard-value choices, ratings, tolerance effects, and the measurements that would verify the result.
checklist: I drew or described the complete source and return path.
I carried units and checked the order of magnitude.
I checked ratings and at least one worst-case condition.
I wrote an observable verification step before viewing the solution.
hints: Start with a symbolic relationship before substituting numbers.
Separate typical behavior from guaranteed limits and add measurement tolerance.
exercises.solutionMarkdown:
## Reference solution

Conduction loss is approximately I²RDS(on)×duty using RDS(on) at the actual gate voltage and hot junction. Switching loss is roughly 0.5VI(tr+tf)fs plus gate-drive loss QgVgfs. Add diode or reverse-recovery loss, then use total dissipation and thermal resistance to estimate junction temperature. Threshold voltage is not the gate-drive specification.

The governing principle is: **choose from guaranteed RDS(on), voltage margin, charge, thermal path, and safe operating area**. Define every reference direction and convert values to coherent SI units. Compare the result with component ratings and standard available values, then report a bounded expectation that includes tolerance, temperature, supply variation, and instrument loading.

### Verification evidence

1. Power off and confirm wiring, polarity, and discharge state.
2. Configure a conservative current limit.
3. Predict source current and the critical node voltages or waveform features.
4. Power on and compare the first measurement with the bounded prediction.
5. Stop if current, temperature, smell, or waveform exceeds the safe bound.

The notebook should make both the reasoning and bench test independently reproducible.

exercises.title: MOSFETs and Power Switching: measurement and fault investigation
exercises.instructionMarkdown: Plan or perform a low-voltage investigation of **threshold used as full-on voltage, floating gate, no dead time, avalanche stress ignored**. Record a safe setup, predicted healthy evidence, observed evidence, one hypothesis at a time, and the final verification.
checklist: I documented the de-energized inspection and safe current limit.
I recorded expected healthy readings before measuring.
I used one falsifiable hypothesis at a time.
I included final evidence that distinguishes cause from symptom.
hints: Measure the supply current and block boundaries before probing internal details.
Change only one condition between measurements.
